meta.purpose: Complete tactical enrichment layer for Tactical Lab. All values are direct inline data — no links, no references. Covers every style vs style matchup (11x11=121 pairs), all passing lane types per style, all role weaknesses, compactness/press/mentality calibration. v2.1 adds clash_weaknesses section.

clash_weaknesses._note: Each style's inherent structural weaknesses — exposed regardless of opponent tactics. Used to inform UI warnings and counter-strategy suggestions.

primary_weaknesses: Vulnerable to immediate counter-press that disrupts triangle rhythm before the third man can receive
Long balls bypass the entire possession structure — aerial duels are not a Tiki-Taka strength
Deep block nullifies the short-passing game — no space to exploit between lines
Slow transition speed means turnovers in the opponent half become dangerous counter opportunities
Over-reliance on technical quality — errors compound under high-intensity pressing
Tiki-Taka.defensive_weakness: High defensive line exposed by balls played in behind
Tiki-Taka.transition_weakness: Slow to recover shape after possession loss — counter window is 3-5 seconds
Tiki-Taka.personnel_weakness: Requires high technical quality in ALL midfield positions — one weak link breaks triangles
Tiki-Taka.compactness_weakness: Spreads wide to recycle — creates gaps centrally when one side is overloaded

primary_weaknesses: Long ball completely bypasses the press — aerial duels cannot be pressed
Space behind the press is enormous when all 4-5 pressers commit simultaneously
High physical demand — press intensity drops sharply after 60 minutes
Counter-attack is lethal once the press is bypassed — committed pressers cannot recover
Requires extreme fitness and coordination — one player not pressing breaks the trap
Gegenpressing.defensive_weakness: CBs exposed when all midfielders press high and ball is played behind
Gegenpressing.transition_weakness: Press recovery time 6-8 seconds — counter window after bypass is large
Gegenpressing.personnel_weakness: All 11 players must press — one lazy presser creates the escape route
Gegenpressing.compactness_weakness: Intentionally stretched vertically to press high — massive space between lines

primary_weaknesses: Counter-attack space behind press is the single biggest weakness
Long ball bypasses press entirely — press becomes irrelevant
Energy drain: cannot maintain press intensity for 90 minutes without rotation
If press is beaten, midfield is bypassed and CBs face pace 1v1
Low block gives nothing to press — style becomes ineffective against passive opponents
High Press.defensive_weakness: High defensive line without pace CBs = aerial ball over the top is catastrophic
High Press.transition_weakness: Press committed — recovery sprint for defenders is 15-20m when bypassed
High Press.personnel_weakness: Requires energetic, press-coordinated forwards — passenger forwards break the press
High Press.compactness_weakness: Presses high so midfield gap below is exploitable if ball skips through

primary_weaknesses: Long ball diagonal into channels behind CBs is the primary threat — even deep blocks cannot defend aerials perfectly
Counter-attack requires quality forwards — without pace up front the block never transitions
Set pieces are both the main attacking AND defending concern — one lapse concedes
Gegenpressing wins the ball high before the block can set — concedes before organized
Vertical Tiki-Taka attacks at pace before the block can fully organize
Deep Block.defensive_weakness: Cannot defend diagonal long ball into the CB-to-touchline channel
Deep Block.transition_weakness: Counter transition requires the ball to travel 60m — very slow attacking start
Deep Block.personnel_weakness: Requires disciplined, physically strong CBs — technical weakness is acceptable
Deep Block.compactness_weakness: Compact centrally but wide channel behind FB is exposed on diagonal ball

primary_weaknesses: Deep block and low block give no space to counter into — style is neutralized
Long Ball Counter has physical aerial advantage over pure Counter-Attack
Requires pace — without fast forwards the counter stalls and opponent recovers
If opponent also absorbs and counters, the transition race is decided by raw speed
Overcommitting a full back or DM on attack removes the counter trigger
Counter-Attack.defensive_weakness: Must commit at least one forward high — flank behind him is open on opponent counter
Counter-Attack.transition_weakness: Counter depends on quick transition — if slowed by opponent recovery it collapses
Counter-Attack.personnel_weakness: Requires pace. Technical finisher up front. Without pace the counter-attack dies
Counter-Attack.compactness_weakness: Deliberately stretched — sits deep but springs forward, leaving transition gap

primary_weaknesses: Second ball must be won — if opponent wins second ball Long Ball resets slowly
Tiki-Taka and possession teams recycle second balls faster than Long Ball can re-launch
Requires a dominant aerial target man — without one, every long ball is wasted
Pass completion is lowest of all styles — possession percentage is very low
Cannot break a well-organized compact block unless aerial duel % is very high
Long Ball.defensive_weakness: Low possession means defending in own half frequently — reactive not proactive
Long Ball.transition_weakness: Long ball reset takes 4-6 seconds from second ball win to next long ball — slow cycle
Long Ball.personnel_weakness: Entirely dependent on target man aerial % — no target man = no style
Long Ball.compactness_weakness: Target man isolated up front — gap between him and teammates is by design but dangerous

primary_weaknesses: Central corridor is vacated — through balls and central penetration are easy
Deep block and low block pack the box — crosses land in traffic
Gegenpressing wins the ball before the cross can be set up
Diagonal counter through the empty centre is lethal when Out Wide attacks
Crossing quality entirely determines goal output — without a good delivery man, style fails
Out Wide.defensive_weakness: Wide players must track back — when they don't, full flank is exposed
Out Wide.transition_weakness: Build-up is slow and wide — counter cuts through the central corridor before wide players recover
Out Wide.personnel_weakness: Requires technically excellent wide players AND a strong aerial target — both are mandatory
Out Wide.compactness_weakness: Width-first approach leaves central midfield exposed — DM must cover alone

primary_weaknesses: Gegenpressing collapses Possession instantly — cannot build under immediate pressure
Deep block and low block give Possession nothing to do with the ball — harmless circulation
Long ball bypasses possession entirely — opponent skips all of their build-up
Counter-attack punishes overcommitted full backs and advancing midfielders
Slow tempo is a weakness vs faster, more direct opponents
Possession.key_vulnerability_zone: Midfield Press Trap + Space Behind Advanced FBs
Possession.defensive_weakness: FBs push high — space behind them is the primary counter-attack corridor
Possession.transition_weakness: Possession loss triggers slow reset — counter window is 4-8 seconds
Possession.personnel_weakness: Requires technically excellent players in ALL positions — any weak link loses the ball
Possession.compactness_weakness: Spreads out to maintain possession — compact defensive shape takes time to re-form

primary_weaknesses: Long ball bypasses the possession + press structure — aerial duels are not the VTT strength
Long Ball Counter exploits the high defensive line with aerial balls over the top
Low block nullifies the vertical progression — no space to play into
Overcommitting in the vertical press creates counter space behind
Requires very high fitness for both pressing and vertical runs — drops off after 70 minutes
Vertical Tiki-Taka.defensive_weakness: High pressing line means space directly behind CBs — one aerial bypasses everything
Vertical Tiki-Taka.transition_weakness: Vertical press committed upfield — CBs exposed when ball is played over the top
Vertical Tiki-Taka.personnel_weakness: Requires fast, intelligent forwards who press AND make vertical runs simultaneously
Vertical Tiki-Taka.compactness_weakness: High pressing creates gap between midfield and defence — exploitable if bypassed

primary_weaknesses: Gegenpressing wins the ball high before the block can set — shop never opens
Long ball diagonal into channel behind CBs — even from deep, channel ball is dangerous
Offers very little attacking threat — requires goal from set piece or rare counter
If opponent goes ahead early, low block must come out and loses its only strength
Long Ball Counter's diagonal aerial is the most effective tool against deep CBs
Low Block.key_vulnerability_zone: Diagonal Aerial Channel + Set Pieces (both ends)
Low Block.defensive_weakness: CBs deep under aerial siege — diagonal ball behind them is nearly unavoidable
Low Block.transition_weakness: Transition from deep requires 70m sprint — counter rarely materializes
Low Block.personnel_weakness: Requires disciplined defensive players who can maintain shape for 90 minutes
Low Block.compactness_weakness: Compact in the box but wide channels behind FBs are exposed when pressed

primary_weaknesses: If aerial duels are lost, the entire strategy collapses — no alternative route
Pass accuracy is lowest of all styles — ball retention is near-zero
Against a team that also plays long ball, whoever has the better target man wins entirely
Short pressing triggers (Gegenpressing on GK/CB) prevent the long ball from being played
Technical possession teams recycle second balls faster, restarting before Long Ball Counter resets
Long Ball Counter.key_vulnerability_zone: Second Ball Zone + GK/CB Press Trigger
Long Ball Counter.defensive_weakness: Low possession means opponent builds freely — only aerial recovery disrupts
Long Ball Counter.transition_weakness: Counter depends on winning aerial + immediate sprint — if aerial is lost the counter never starts
Long Ball Counter.personnel_weakness: 100% dependent on physical target man. No target man = no style at all
Long Ball Counter.compactness_weakness: Target man isolated 50m from defensive line — massive structural gap by design

style_vs_style._note: Full 11x11 matrix. attacker = styleA (my team), defender = styleB (opponent). score_adjust matches the app's internal l variable logic. exploitable_lanes = passing lane types styleA should use. shut_down_lanes = what styleB cuts off. weakness_exposed = styleB weakness styleA targets. key_zone = where the decisive battle happens.

vs_Tiki-Taka.weakness_exposed: mirror possession battle — width and individual quality decide
vs_Tiki-Taka.how_to_win: Overload one halfspace, force a switch, exploit the transition moment when opponent repositions.
vs_Tiki-Taka.counter_tactic: Hold shape, patience — do not chase the ball or gaps appear.

vs_Gegenpressing.weakness_exposed: Gegenpressing kills short triangle — bypass with quick switches
vs_Gegenpressing.how_to_win: Play out wide immediately to avoid press traps. One-touch in tight zones. SK on ball to draw press then switch.
vs_Gegenpressing.counter_tactic: Press every Tiki-Taka triangle immediately — force the 3rd man to rush.

vs_High Press.weakness_exposed: High press disrupts build-up rhythm — switch play quickly to exploit gaps
vs_High Press.how_to_win: Draw the press, switch to the weak side in 2 passes. Space appears behind pressing lines.
vs_High Press.counter_tactic: Press the first triangle receiver — never let them turn.

vs_Deep Block.weakness_exposed: Deep block concedes wide areas — overload halfspaces and cut inside
vs_Deep Block.how_to_win: Wide overloads, early cutbacks, halfspace penetration. Never go direct — the block is set for that.
vs_Deep Block.counter_tactic: Sit compact, concede wide, block the cutback lane with a tracking runner.

vs_Counter-Attack.weakness_exposed: Counter waits for possession loss — slow build-up gives them set positions
vs_Counter-Attack.how_to_win: Maintain possession, never overcommit. When countered, immediate counter-press to stop the break.
vs_Counter-Attack.counter_tactic: Sit deep, absorb, release early to the wide runners on turnover.

vs_Long Ball.weakness_exposed: Long ball bypasses the press — win second balls to re-establish
vs_Long Ball.how_to_win: Win second balls after long balls land. Own the space around the target man. Pass through their lines before the aerial duel resets.
vs_Long Ball.counter_tactic: Bypass midfield entirely — long ball directly every possession.

vs_Out Wide.weakness_exposed: Out Wide neglects centre — central corridor is open
vs_Out Wide.how_to_win: Overload the centre, play through the middle. Opponent's width obsession leaves central defenders exposed 2v2.
vs_Out Wide.counter_tactic: Force play wide — narrow the centre with a flat 4.

vs_Possession.weakness_exposed: Possession style yields more space in transition — exploit the switch
vs_Possession.how_to_win: Move the ball faster, create numerical superiority in one halfspace then switch. Make opponent chase.
vs_Possession.counter_tactic: Control tempo, never be pulled out of shape chasing.

vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.weakness_exposed: Vertical TT presses harder and progresses faster — need to match intensity
vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.how_to_win: Slow the game, recycle more, make them chase. Vertical TT hates a patient opponent.
vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.counter_tactic: Press higher and faster — don't let them recycle.

vs_Low Block.weakness_exposed: Low block gives up wide — exploit halfspaces obsessively
vs_Low Block.how_to_win: Relentless wide overloads, late runs from midfield. Vary delivery — cross, cutback, pull-back, square. Never go through the middle.
vs_Low Block.counter_tactic: 10 behind the ball, concede width, block everything in the box.

vs_Long Ball Counter.weakness_exposed: Long Ball Counter bypasses possession press with aerials — win second balls
vs_Long Ball Counter.how_to_win: Win second balls, press immediately after each long ball. Keep possession after winning it — don't give it back.
vs_Long Ball Counter.counter_tactic: Every possession ends in a long ball to the target man — no short build-up.

vs_Tiki-Taka.weakness_exposed: Tiki-Taka collapses under immediate counter-press — triangles break
vs_Tiki-Taka.how_to_win: Press every triangle immediately, force backwards pass, press again. Create chaos in their build-up rhythm.
vs_Tiki-Taka.counter_tactic: One-touch out of pressure — never hold the ball.

vs_Gegenpressing.weakness_exposed: Mirror — space behind both pressing lines decides it
vs_Gegenpressing.how_to_win: Press triggers first. Draw opponent's press then switch — massive space opens behind their committed pressers.
vs_Gegenpressing.counter_tactic: Same — press triggers first, switch before they reset.

vs_High Press.weakness_exposed: High Press is less intense than Gegenpressing — outwork them
vs_High Press.how_to_win: Win the press intensity battle. More aggressive, more immediate. Force mistakes higher up the pitch.
vs_High Press.counter_tactic: One long ball to bypass the press — they have no DM safety net.

vs_Deep Block.weakness_exposed: Deep block is passive — Gegenpressing wins the ball high constantly
vs_Deep Block.how_to_win: Win the ball high repeatedly, shoot immediately. Deep block never sets when opponent is always pressing.
vs_Deep Block.counter_tactic: Absorb, absorb, launch a fast counter on turnover before Gegenpressing resets.

vs_Counter-Attack.weakness_exposed: Counter explodes behind Gegenpressing's committed press — lethal
vs_Counter-Attack.how_to_win: Keep one midfielder back always. Never commit all pressers simultaneously. Press in waves not all at once.
vs_Counter-Attack.counter_tactic: Invite the press, one touch out, sprint behind immediately.

vs_Long Ball.weakness_exposed: Long ball bypasses Gegenpressing entirely — press is useless against aerial bypass
vs_Long Ball.how_to_win: Minimize possession loss. When you have the ball, be direct. Win the second balls after aerials aggressively.
vs_Long Ball.counter_tactic: Never build short — every possession is a long ball immediately.

vs_Out Wide.weakness_exposed: Out Wide is slow — Gegenpressing wins the ball before they can set up crosses
vs_Out Wide.how_to_win: Press their wide players before they can cross. Win the ball high on the flanks, transition immediately.
vs_Out Wide.counter_tactic: Play fast wide combinations — don't let the presser get set.

vs_Possession.weakness_exposed: Possession style can't handle Gegenpressing intensity — collapses
vs_Possession.how_to_win: Press every receiver immediately. Possession teams hate urgency — create it everywhere.
vs_Possession.counter_tactic: Move the ball in 1-2 touches. Never hold under pressure.

vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.weakness_exposed: Vertical TT moves fast enough to escape the counter-press
vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.how_to_win: Press before they can play vertical. Stop the first forward pass — if they get vertical it's already too late.
vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.counter_tactic: Play fast and direct — get behind the press in 2 passes.

vs_Low Block.weakness_exposed: Low block never gets to set — Gegenpressing wins ball constantly in their half
vs_Low Block.how_to_win: Win the ball high, shoot immediately from recovered positions. 30% of Gegenpressing goals come within 6 seconds of recovery.
vs_Low Block.counter_tactic: Kick it long every time — no point building from the back.

vs_Long Ball Counter.weakness_exposed: Long Ball Counter destroys Gegenpressing — aerial bypass kills the press
vs_Long Ball Counter.how_to_win: Win second balls. Have a DM hold position. Reduce press triggers so fewer are caught behind aerials.
vs_Long Ball Counter.counter_tactic: Long ball every single time — aerial duel wins the match.

vs_Tiki-Taka.weakness_exposed: Tiki-Taka is designed to escape the press — triangles absorb pressure
vs_Tiki-Taka.how_to_win: Press harder, cut off the triangle third man. Force long balls with aggressive press trap.
vs_Tiki-Taka.counter_tactic: One-touch out then switch — press trap only works if ball sticks.

vs_Gegenpressing.weakness_exposed: Gegenpressing outpresses High Press in intensity
vs_Gegenpressing.how_to_win: Structured press trap — don't freelance. Coordinate press triggers so no one chases alone.
vs_Gegenpressing.counter_tactic: Outwork them — more pressers, more energy, win every second ball.

vs_High Press.weakness_exposed: Mirror — depth of defensive line and number of active pressers decides
vs_High Press.how_to_win: Get more press triggers up the pitch. Get your forwards higher. Win the geometry battle.
vs_High Press.counter_tactic: Same — whoever has more forwards above y=180 wins the press battle.

vs_Deep Block.weakness_exposed: Deep block absorbs and counters — High Press can't unlock a compact low shape
vs_Deep Block.how_to_win: Patient wide play, halfspace rotations, late runners from midfield. Press is useless — save energy for possession phases.
vs_Deep Block.counter_tactic: Let them have the ball high, absorb, counter with pace.

vs_Counter-Attack.weakness_exposed: Counter is lethal against High Press — space behind is huge
vs_Counter-Attack.how_to_win: Press in stages, never all at once. Keep your DM sitting. Only press when numerical advantage exists.
vs_Counter-Attack.counter_tactic: Invite press, one touch release to wide runner in space behind.

vs_Long Ball.weakness_exposed: Long ball bypasses High Press — aerials win the match not the press
vs_Long Ball.how_to_win: Win aerial duels second ball. Reduce the gap behind your press. Keep CBs higher so recovery run is shorter.
vs_Long Ball.counter_tactic: Long ball immediately — don't let them press.

vs_Out Wide.weakness_exposed: Out Wide is slow to build — High Press wins ball before crosses form
vs_Out Wide.how_to_win: Press the wide players before they get the ball. Out Wide breaks down under press — cross delivery is the whole plan.
vs_Out Wide.counter_tactic: Speed up wide play — 1-2-cross before press arrives.

vs_Possession.weakness_exposed: Possession is slow — High Press disrupts their rhythm
vs_Possession.how_to_win: Press at every pass. Force backwards passes. Possession teams hate going backwards under pressure.
vs_Possession.counter_tactic: Move the ball quickly — no holding.

vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.weakness_exposed: Vertical TT moves too fast for the press to trap
vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.how_to_win: Double up on the first receiver. Force the mistake in their half. One mistake from VTT ends possession quickly.
vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.counter_tactic: Play vertically before the press sets — don't let them trap.

vs_Low Block.weakness_exposed: Low block cannot be high-pressed — there's nothing to press
vs_Low Block.how_to_win: Abandon the press, build possession, attack wide. Press mentality must switch to patient possession when facing low block.
vs_Low Block.counter_tactic: Sit, absorb, hit on the counter.

vs_Long Ball Counter.weakness_exposed: Long Ball Counter is High Press's worst nightmare — aerial bypasses all press
vs_Long Ball Counter.how_to_win: Win second balls obsessively. Keep CBs from being isolated 1v1. DM must sit regardless of press.
vs_Long Ball Counter.counter_tactic: Every possession is a long ball. Win aerial, sprint, score.

vs_Tiki-Taka.weakness_exposed: Tiki-Taka cannot break a disciplined deep block — patience becomes their weakness
vs_Tiki-Taka.how_to_win: Absorb 70% possession, launch direct counter when ball is won. Target the space behind their high defensive line.
vs_Tiki-Taka.counter_tactic: Wide overloads, halfspace penetration, cutbacks — never go direct.

vs_Gegenpressing.weakness_exposed: Gegenpressing wins ball high and shoots immediately — deep block has no time to set
vs_Gegenpressing.how_to_win: Survive the first 20 minutes. Clear long every possession. Waste time. Make it ugly.
vs_Gegenpressing.counter_tactic: Win ball high, shoot fast. Don't let them get comfortable.

vs_High Press.weakness_exposed: High Press burns stamina against a deep block — exploit their tiredness after 60 min
vs_High Press.how_to_win: Absorb, absorb, counter. The longer the game, the better. High press runs out of energy against a deep block.
vs_High Press.counter_tactic: Be patient — the goal will come. Never press more than 2 men at once.

vs_Deep Block.weakness_exposed: Mirror stalemate — set pieces and individual quality decide
vs_Deep Block.how_to_win: Attack their set piece organization. The only way through a deep block vs deep block is a mistake or a set piece.

vs_Counter-Attack.weakness_exposed: Counter needs space behind — deep block gives no space
vs_Counter-Attack.how_to_win: Give no space behind your block. Counter can't counter a team that doesn't attack. Force them to come to you.
vs_Counter-Attack.counter_tactic: Counter only when a clear 3v2 opportunity exists. Never chase.

vs_Long Ball.weakness_exposed: Long ball hits over the deep block top — aerial threat bypasses the shape
vs_Long Ball.how_to_win: Win aerial duels first. Deep block is vulnerable to diagonal long balls behind the CB line.
vs_Long Ball.counter_tactic: Play over the top — the deep block's CBs are its only weakness under aerial.

vs_Out Wide.weakness_exposed: Deep block can narrow to shut wide play — Out Wide is neutralised
vs_Out Wide.how_to_win: Sit narrowly, force crosses into traffic. Out Wide hates a narrow compact block that wins every header.
vs_Out Wide.counter_tactic: Pull defenders wide then cut back — don't cross into a crowded box.

vs_Possession.weakness_exposed: Possession is toothless against a deep block — concedes no dangerous space
vs_Possession.how_to_win: Absorb their possession, counter with direct ball. 60% of deep block goals come from turnovers in own half.
vs_Possession.counter_tactic: Wide penetration, halfspaces, late runs — never through the middle.

vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.weakness_exposed: Vertical TT progresses faster than deep block can absorb
vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.how_to_win: Get 10 behind the ball before they enter the final third. Delay the vertical progression.
vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.counter_tactic: Attack at pace — don't let the block organize.

vs_Low Block.weakness_exposed: Mirror — deeper block wins by conceding even less space
vs_Low Block.how_to_win: Deep block vs low block is decided entirely by set pieces. Win aerial duels at both ends.

vs_Long Ball Counter.weakness_exposed: Deep block's CBs are under aerial siege — long ball counter dominates
vs_Long Ball Counter.how_to_win: Win every aerial. Get a physical CB partnership. Deep block loses to long ball when aerial duel % drops below 50%.
vs_Long Ball Counter.counter_tactic: Long ball, win aerial, sprint in behind — repeat every possession.

vs_Tiki-Taka.weakness_exposed: Tiki-Taka's high line leaves space behind — counter exploits it perfectly
vs_Tiki-Taka.how_to_win: Invite possession, absorb, then release your fastest players into the space behind their defensive line in one move.
vs_Tiki-Taka.counter_tactic: Counter-counter — press the break immediately with 3+ players.

vs_Gegenpressing.weakness_exposed: Gegenpressing's aggressive press leaves space behind — counter sprints into it
vs_Gegenpressing.how_to_win: Invite the press. One-touch release. Sprint behind before they can recover. Speed of transition is everything.
vs_Gegenpressing.counter_tactic: Keep one midfielder back always to stop the transition.

vs_High Press.weakness_exposed: High Press creates space behind — Counter feasts on this
vs_High Press.how_to_win: Play to the press, one touch out, sprint. High press means their CBs are often high — 1v1s are available.
vs_High Press.counter_tactic: Press less — the more you press, the more space you give.

vs_Deep Block.weakness_exposed: Deep block gives no space to counter into — Counter neutralized
vs_Deep Block.how_to_win: Force deep block to come out. Go down early if possible. Set pieces become the equalizer.
vs_Deep Block.counter_tactic: Never push up — give Counter nothing to run into.

vs_Counter-Attack.weakness_exposed: Mirror — whoever has faster attackers wins
vs_Counter-Attack.how_to_win: Transition faster. Deploy your quickest players wide. Win the race for the first counter.
vs_Counter-Attack.counter_tactic: Same — speed and clinical finishing decide it.

vs_Long Ball.weakness_exposed: Long ball is slow and predictable — Counter transitions faster
vs_Long Ball.how_to_win: Win second balls after aerials, transition immediately. Counter is faster through the ground than Long Ball through the air.
vs_Long Ball.counter_tactic: Never long ball — play ground pass combinations to set up the sprint.

vs_Out Wide.weakness_exposed: Out Wide builds slowly — Counter hits before they can set up
vs_Out Wide.how_to_win: Allow width, press central, counter through the middle. Out Wide vacates the centre — exploit it.
vs_Out Wide.counter_tactic: Don't build slowly — speed up wide play to prevent counter opportunity.

vs_Possession.weakness_exposed: Possession teams overcommit forward — Counter sprints into the gaps
vs_Possession.how_to_win: Let them have the ball. They'll push forward. One turnover = instant chance. Keep your wide forwards pinned high.
vs_Possession.counter_tactic: Keep a defensive midfielder back. Never push a full back forward.

vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.weakness_exposed: Vertical TT also transitions fast — mirror race
vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.how_to_win: Match their intensity. Don't let them transition — press back immediately on every loss.
vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.counter_tactic: Play vertical fast — get behind before counter can absorb.

vs_Low Block.weakness_exposed: Low block gives Counter nothing to run into
vs_Low Block.how_to_win: Force them to come out. Score first. Go direct over the top — only strategy that works.
vs_Low Block.counter_tactic: Never push up — stay compact, never give space.

vs_Long Ball Counter.weakness_exposed: Long Ball Counter mirrors Counter but adds aerial dimension — physical advantage
vs_Long Ball Counter.how_to_win: Win second balls. Make it a ground game. If they win aerials they win the transition battle.
vs_Long Ball Counter.counter_tactic: Long ball every time — physical superiority decides counter battles.

vs_Tiki-Taka.weakness_exposed: Tiki-Taka wins second balls — long ball only works if aerials stick
vs_Tiki-Taka.how_to_win: Target the wide CB. Win the aerial. Sprint the second ball wide before Tiki-Taka resets. Never let them recycle.
vs_Tiki-Taka.counter_tactic: Win second balls immediately, recycle possession before they transition.

vs_Gegenpressing.weakness_exposed: Gegenpressing cannot press what it can't reach — long ball bypasses entirely
vs_Gegenpressing.how_to_win: Every possession ends in a long ball. Never give Gegenpressing a player to press. Aerial duel is the whole game.
vs_Gegenpressing.counter_tactic: Win second balls. Press the target man before the aerial — not after.

vs_High Press.weakness_exposed: High Press is bypassed completely by long ball — press is irrelevant
vs_High Press.how_to_win: Long ball every time. High Press wastes energy pressing nobody. Win aerials and the match is won.
vs_High Press.counter_tactic: Abandon the press — sit deep and defend the second ball.

vs_Deep Block.weakness_exposed: Deep block CBs not prepared for aerial siege — long ball creates confusion
vs_Deep Block.how_to_win: Target the CB-to-CB gap with diagonal long balls. Deep blocks hate balls played into the channel over the top.
vs_Deep Block.counter_tactic: Head every ball away. Win the second ball with your DM. Neutralize the target man with a physical CB.

vs_Counter-Attack.weakness_exposed: Counter transitions faster than long ball can reset
vs_Counter-Attack.how_to_win: Win the aerial quickly and sprint immediately — don't let the counter reset. Speed of second ball matters most.
vs_Counter-Attack.counter_tactic: Press the second ball immediately after aerial — never give the target man a moment.

vs_Long Ball.weakness_exposed: Mirror aerial battle — physical quality of target man decides
vs_Long Ball.how_to_win: Win more aerials. Target their weaker CB. Play diagonal balls not straight — harder to defend.
vs_Long Ball.counter_tactic: Same — whoever wins 55%+ of aerials wins the match.

vs_Out Wide.weakness_exposed: Out Wide and Long Ball both use the flanks — corridor battle
vs_Out Wide.how_to_win: Win the flank battle. Long ball into the wide channel, wide runner sprints on to it. Simpler than crossing.
vs_Out Wide.counter_tactic: Win the wide duel. Don't let them play the channel ball — get tight on the winger.

vs_Possession.weakness_exposed: Possession teams are bypassed — long ball skips their entire structure
vs_Possession.how_to_win: Bypass their possession with long balls. They're set up to play through lines — go over the top of all of them.
vs_Possession.counter_tactic: Win second balls every time. Aerial bypass is only dangerous if the second ball is won.

vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.weakness_exposed: Vertical TT high line is exposed by long ball
vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.how_to_win: Aerial bypass over the high VTT defensive line. Target the space behind their CBs relentlessly.
vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.counter_tactic: Drop the defensive line slightly — sacrifice some press for aerial protection.

vs_Low Block.weakness_exposed: Low block CBs deep under aerial siege — long diagonal ball is lethal
vs_Low Block.how_to_win: Diagonal long balls into the wide channel. Low block can't defend aerials without pushing a CB wide — that opens the centre.
vs_Low Block.counter_tactic: Win every header. Clear long and far. Never let the second ball land near your goal.

vs_Long Ball Counter.weakness_exposed: Mirror aerial battle — nearly identical game
vs_Long Ball Counter.how_to_win: Win the aerial duel %. Same style — whoever has the stronger target man wins.

vs_Tiki-Taka.weakness_exposed: Tiki-Taka narrows to shut wide play — need the cutback not the cross
vs_Tiki-Taka.how_to_win: Don't cross early. Carry to the byline, pull back. Tiki-Taka's defensive compactness can't handle a low cutback.
vs_Tiki-Taka.counter_tactic: Shift to cover the width — track every runner. Never let them cross.

vs_Gegenpressing.weakness_exposed: Gegenpressing wins the ball before Out Wide can set up crosses
vs_Gegenpressing.how_to_win: Speed up wide play. 1-2 on the flank, immediate cross. Never hold — Gegenpressing will arrive.
vs_Gegenpressing.counter_tactic: Press the wide player before they can cross — kill the delivery.

vs_High Press.weakness_exposed: High Press disrupts the wide build-up — crosses never form under pressure
vs_High Press.how_to_win: Protect the wide players from press. Use overlapping FB to create 2v1 on the flank before crossing.
vs_High Press.counter_tactic: Press the wide build-up early, force backwards. Kill the overlap.

vs_Deep Block.weakness_exposed: Deep block packs the penalty area — crosses land in traffic
vs_Deep Block.how_to_win: Pull-backs and cut-backs not crosses. Drag a runner to the far post then play to the near post. Never head-on cross.
vs_Deep Block.counter_tactic: Pack the box. Head everything. Win every aerial in the box.

vs_Counter-Attack.weakness_exposed: Wide build-up is slow — Counter sprints while Out Wide crosses
vs_Counter-Attack.how_to_win: Keep width but track back immediately when possession is lost. Wide forwards must defend or flanks are open.
vs_Counter-Attack.counter_tactic: When they build wide, sprint the other flank — the opposite side is empty.

vs_Long Ball.weakness_exposed: Both wide-focused — flank battle determines winner
vs_Long Ball.how_to_win: Win the 1v1 wide duel. Out Wide beats Long Ball when the winger wins the duel and the cross finds a head.
vs_Long Ball.counter_tactic: Long ball into the channel — bypass the wide build-up with aerial.

vs_Out Wide.weakness_exposed: Mirror wide battle — crossing quality and box headers decide
vs_Out Wide.how_to_win: Win more 1v1 wide duels. Play the diagonal switch when one wide side is locked — open the other.
vs_Out Wide.counter_tactic: Same — defend crosses, win headers, attack the other flank.

vs_Possession.weakness_exposed: Possession style leaves wide areas — Out Wide exploits the flanks
vs_Possession.how_to_win: Exploit possession style's central focus. Attack wide immediately. Their FBs push high — space on the flank.
vs_Possession.counter_tactic: Track the wide runners with the FB. Never let them cross freely.

vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.weakness_exposed: Vertical TT presses the wide build-up before the cross forms
vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.how_to_win: Protect wide players. Play 1-2 combinations on the flank. Never hold ball in wide areas.
vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.counter_tactic: Press wide players immediately — no time on the ball.

vs_Low Block.weakness_exposed: Low block packs the box — crosses find no space
vs_Low Block.how_to_win: Pull-backs, drag-backs, cutbacks. Shoot from outside the box. Draw a foul. Never cross straight.
vs_Low Block.counter_tactic: 10 men in the box. Head every cross away.

vs_Long Ball Counter.weakness_exposed: Long Ball Counter is physical — Out Wide technical wide play vs aerial power
vs_Long Ball Counter.how_to_win: Win the wide duel on the ground. Cross low — Long Ball Counter's physical CBs are better in the air than on the ground.
vs_Long Ball Counter.counter_tactic: Win aerial, sprint wide, cross — bypass Out Wide's technical build-up.

vs_Tiki-Taka.weakness_exposed: Mirror possession — movement and positional quality decide
vs_Tiki-Taka.how_to_win: Circulate faster. Possession teams lose to more dynamic possession teams. Speed of ball movement, not just retention, wins.
vs_Tiki-Taka.counter_tactic: Match their pace of passing. Never press — absorb and wait for the switch.

vs_Gegenpressing.weakness_exposed: Gegenpressing kills Possession — triangles collapse under immediate press
vs_Gegenpressing.how_to_win: Move in 1 touch. Switch play before they can press. Play to feet not into space — keeps the triangle intact.
vs_Gegenpressing.counter_tactic: Press every receiver immediately. Possession only works when there's time on the ball.

vs_High Press.weakness_exposed: High Press disrupts Possession rhythm — forces long balls
vs_High Press.how_to_win: SK and ball-playing CBs. Never panic under press — play out calmly. One switch to the open FB escapes any press.
vs_High Press.counter_tactic: Press the first receiver every time. Force the error. Never back off.

vs_Deep Block.weakness_exposed: Possession cannot break a disciplined deep block
vs_Deep Block.how_to_win: Halfspace overloads. Players arriving late. Vary the delivery — low cross, cutback, shot from outside. Never predictable.
vs_Deep Block.counter_tactic: Stay compact. Never be pulled out of shape. Concede the possession — it won't hurt.

vs_Counter-Attack.weakness_exposed: Possession overcommits forward — Counter waits for the mistake
vs_Counter-Attack.how_to_win: Never overcommit. Keep a DM sitting. Never push both FBs forward at the same time. Counter-press immediately on every loss.
vs_Counter-Attack.counter_tactic: Absorb, absorb, release the quick forwards on turnover.

vs_Long Ball.weakness_exposed: Possession is bypassed by long ball — all that passing is skipped
vs_Long Ball.how_to_win: Win second balls. After winning aerial second ball, restart possession immediately. Don't panic into long balls.
vs_Long Ball.counter_tactic: Long ball every possession. Bypass all the possession play.

vs_Out Wide.weakness_exposed: Out Wide occupies the flank — Possession loses the width battle
vs_Out Wide.how_to_win: Narrow possession. Play through the halfspaces rather than wide. Out Wide leaves the centre open.
vs_Out Wide.counter_tactic: Force them inside. Deny width. Their possession collapses without wide options.

vs_Possession.weakness_exposed: Mirror — technical quality and press intensity decide
vs_Possession.how_to_win: Move the ball faster. Create more 2v1 situations. Outpass them in quality not quantity.
vs_Possession.counter_tactic: Match pace. Wait for a mistake.

vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.weakness_exposed: Vertical TT is Possession but faster and more direct — outclasses pure Possession
vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.how_to_win: Slow the game. Recycle more. Don't be drawn into a fast-tempo battle — Vertical TT wins that.
vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.counter_tactic: Play fast and direct. Don't let Possession slow the tempo.

vs_Low Block.weakness_exposed: Low block renders Possession harmless — no space to exploit
vs_Low Block.how_to_win: Halfspace overloads, late runners, cutbacks. Draw a foul. Set pieces are the only reliable threat vs low block.
vs_Low Block.counter_tactic: Stay low. Never come out. Let them circulate — they'll run out of ideas.

vs_Long Ball Counter.weakness_exposed: Long Ball Counter bypasses Possession entirely and counters the transition
vs_Long Ball Counter.how_to_win: Win second balls. Keep a DM sitting. After winning aerial, restart possession calmly. Never panic.
vs_Long Ball Counter.counter_tactic: Long ball, win aerial, counter immediately. Skip Possession's entire build-up phase.

vs_Tiki-Taka.weakness_exposed: Standard Tiki-Taka is slower — Vertical TT outpaces the recycling
vs_Tiki-Taka.how_to_win: Play faster and more direct. Tiki-Taka's triangle is slower — beat it with vertical progression before they set.
vs_Tiki-Taka.counter_tactic: Move in 1 touch. Speed up the triangle to match vertical intensity.

vs_Gegenpressing.weakness_exposed: Vertical TT moves before Gegenpressing can press — too fast to trap
vs_Gegenpressing.how_to_win: Play 1-2 touch vertical. Be past the presser before they arrive. VTT wins when the ball moves faster than the press.
vs_Gegenpressing.counter_tactic: Press earlier — anticipate the vertical pass, not react to it.

vs_High Press.weakness_exposed: High Press is beaten by fast vertical play — press arrives too late
vs_High Press.how_to_win: Play vertical balls through the press. High press creates space — the through ball into that space is lethal.
vs_High Press.counter_tactic: Drop the press line — stop pressing so high.

vs_Deep Block.weakness_exposed: Deep block is passive — Vertical TT's speed overwhelms the passive defense
vs_Deep Block.how_to_win: Attack the block at pace. Vertical TT's speed of progression doesn't allow the block to organize fully.
vs_Deep Block.counter_tactic: Organize quickly. Deep block only works if the shape is set before the attack arrives.

vs_Counter-Attack.weakness_exposed: Both fast transition styles — mirror race
vs_Counter-Attack.how_to_win: Win the possession battle first. Vertical TT plus possession = Counter has nothing to counter from.
vs_Counter-Attack.counter_tactic: One touch release on turnover. Sprint before Vertical TT can press back.

vs_Long Ball.weakness_exposed: Long ball bypasses Vertical TT's possession structure with aerials
vs_Long Ball.how_to_win: Win second balls. Keep a DM sitting. Don't get drawn into an aerial battle — play short after winning the aerial.
vs_Long Ball.counter_tactic: Long ball every possession. Skip their entire vertical structure.

vs_Out Wide.weakness_exposed: Out Wide is slow — Vertical TT's pace beats the slow cross build-up
vs_Out Wide.how_to_win: Press Out Wide's build-up. Win the ball on the flank, play vertical immediately. Beat them to the chance.
vs_Out Wide.counter_tactic: Speed up wide play dramatically. 1-2-cross in 3 touches.

vs_Possession.weakness_exposed: Possession is slower and less direct — Vertical TT outclasses it
vs_Possession.how_to_win: Play faster and more vertical. Possession teams will slow the game — refuse to slow down with them.
vs_Possession.counter_tactic: Slow the tempo. Force a long possession game. Vertical TT loses its advantage in a slow match.

vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.weakness_exposed: Mirror — quality of individuals in vertical passes decides
vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.how_to_win: Make higher quality vertical passes. Win the key 1v1 duels in the halfspace. Individual quality is the decider.
vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.counter_tactic: Same. Quality of through ball and runner's timing decides it.

vs_Low Block.weakness_exposed: Low block nullifies vertical play — no space to play into
vs_Low Block.how_to_win: Switch to patient wide play when facing low block. Vertical TT must adapt — go wide not through.
vs_Low Block.counter_tactic: Stay deep. Never come out. Vertical TT runs out of space to be vertical.

vs_Long Ball Counter.weakness_exposed: Long Ball Counter bypasses Vertical TT with aerials and counters
vs_Long Ball Counter.how_to_win: Win second balls. Keep a DM back. Don't let the aerial winner transition — press immediately.
vs_Long Ball Counter.counter_tactic: Long ball, win aerial, sprint. Vertical TT's high line is exposed behind.

vs_Tiki-Taka.weakness_exposed: Tiki-Taka cannot break a low block — all their passes go sideways
vs_Tiki-Taka.how_to_win: Absorb everything. 10 men behind the ball always. Counter with one direct ball over the top when possession is won.
vs_Tiki-Taka.counter_tactic: Wide overloads. Cutbacks. Set pieces. Patience beyond any reasonable limit.

vs_Gegenpressing.weakness_exposed: Gegenpressing wins ball high and shoots immediately — low block never gets to set
vs_Gegenpressing.how_to_win: Clear everything long and high. Never try to play out from the back against Gegenpressing. Get the ball as far forward as possible.
vs_Gegenpressing.counter_tactic: Win ball high, shoot immediately. Low block's only weakness is speed of transition from press to shot.

vs_High Press.weakness_exposed: High Press burns stamina pressing a low block that gives them nothing
vs_High Press.how_to_win: Absorb the press. Clear long. Counter-attack in the final 20 minutes when they're exhausted. Set pieces win matches.
vs_High Press.counter_tactic: Patient crossing and cutbacks. Never go direct. Never press — they want you to press.

vs_Deep Block.weakness_exposed: Deep block vs Low block — Low block is deeper so slightly better defensively
vs_Deep Block.how_to_win: Set pieces only. Win the aerial battle at both ends. Low block is slightly deeper — harder to create against.
vs_Deep Block.counter_tactic: Defend set pieces. Wait for your chance on the counter.

vs_Counter-Attack.weakness_exposed: Counter needs space — low block gives none
vs_Counter-Attack.how_to_win: Never come out. Counter has nothing to counter. Force them to attack you. Wait for set piece or mistake.
vs_Counter-Attack.counter_tactic: Never attack unless a clear 3v2 or better. Stay patient.

vs_Long Ball.weakness_exposed: Long ball targets the CBs who are deep — diagonal aerials are dangerous at any depth
vs_Long Ball.how_to_win: Win every header. Never let the second ball bounce. CBs must dominate aerials from a deep position.
vs_Long Ball.counter_tactic: Diagonal long balls into the channel. Low block CBs deep = channel ball is dangerous.

vs_Out Wide.weakness_exposed: Out Wide's crosses find a packed box — 10 men heading everything
vs_Out Wide.how_to_win: Pack the box. Win every header. Out Wide has no answer to a compact, deep, header-winning block.
vs_Out Wide.counter_tactic: Pull-backs and drag-backs. Shoot from outside. Draw a penalty. Nothing else works.

vs_Possession.weakness_exposed: Possession is powerless vs low block — all their passing is harmless
vs_Possession.how_to_win: Absorb 70% possession safely. Counter in the final 20 minutes. Set pieces are the equalizer.
vs_Possession.counter_tactic: Only halfspace overloads and cutbacks work. Patience beyond patience.

vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.weakness_exposed: Vertical TT has nowhere to be vertical — no space exists in low block
vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.how_to_win: Sit very deep. Vertical TT's advantage is speed into space — give no space.
vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.counter_tactic: Wide play only. Cutbacks. The vertical through balls are impossible — play around not through.

vs_Low Block.weakness_exposed: Perfect stalemate — decided only by set pieces
vs_Low Block.how_to_win: Win set piece duels. That's the only thing that separates two low blocks.

vs_Long Ball Counter.weakness_exposed: Long Ball Counter's aerials expose even the low block — diagonal balls are lethal
vs_Long Ball Counter.how_to_win: Win every single aerial. Low block is vulnerable to diagonal long balls at any depth. CB physicality is everything.
vs_Long Ball Counter.counter_tactic: Diagonal long ball into the channel — the only weak point of a low block.

vs_Tiki-Taka.weakness_exposed: Tiki-Taka's high line is exposed by long ball — aerial over the top
vs_Tiki-Taka.how_to_win: Long ball every possession. Win the aerial. Sprint immediately. Tiki-Taka's defensive line is high and exposed.
vs_Tiki-Taka.counter_tactic: Win second balls. Drop the CB line slightly when you have possession.

vs_Gegenpressing.weakness_exposed: Gegenpressing has nothing to press — long ball bypasses everything
vs_Gegenpressing.how_to_win: Long ball to the target man every single possession. Gegenpressing is useless when the ball skips the midfield entirely.
vs_Gegenpressing.counter_tactic: Press before the long ball is played — press the GK and CBs to prevent the ball reaching the target man.

vs_High Press.weakness_exposed: High Press cannot press a long ball — the target man receives in the final third freely
vs_High Press.how_to_win: Long ball to target man every time. High press is completely bypassed. Target man holds, runners sprint.
vs_High Press.counter_tactic: Abandon the press. Drop deep. Defend the second ball.

vs_Deep Block.weakness_exposed: Deep block CBs under aerial siege — long ball into the channel from deep
vs_Deep Block.how_to_win: Diagonal long ball into the channel behind the CB. Deep block is still vulnerable to the ball played behind the deepest player.
vs_Deep Block.counter_tactic: Win every header. Stay deep. Never come out to meet the long ball — head it from your position.

vs_Counter-Attack.weakness_exposed: Long Ball Counter adds aerial to Counter — more dimensions than pure Counter
vs_Counter-Attack.how_to_win: Win aerial, counter immediately. Long Ball Counter has the aerial route AND the pace route — Counter only has pace.
vs_Counter-Attack.counter_tactic: Win second balls before the sprint starts. The sprint is unstoppable — prevent the aerial win.

vs_Long Ball.weakness_exposed: Mirror — Long Ball Counter adds the sprint but both are aerial-dependent
vs_Long Ball.how_to_win: Win more aerials. Long Ball Counter adds the sprint to Long Ball — slightly faster transition after the aerial.
vs_Long Ball.counter_tactic: Win second balls. Long Ball Counter is only dangerous after the aerial — stop it there.

vs_Out Wide.weakness_exposed: Both wide-focused — physical vs technical battle
vs_Out Wide.how_to_win: Win physical 1v1s wide. Long Ball Counter adds the aerial dimension to wide play — cross from aerial wins.
vs_Out Wide.counter_tactic: Win wide duels. Don't give them the aerial — keep it on the ground.

vs_Possession.weakness_exposed: Possession is bypassed by long ball — all that passing is skipped and countered
vs_Possession.how_to_win: Long ball to bypass possession, win aerial, sprint. Possession has no answer to this — they're designed to build, not defend aerials.
vs_Possession.counter_tactic: Win second balls. Counter-press after every lost aerial.

vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.weakness_exposed: VTT high line exposed behind — long ball destroys the high defensive shape
vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.how_to_win: Long ball over the VTT defensive line. Their high line is aggressive — the space behind is massive. Target it every time.
vs_Vertical Tiki-Taka.counter_tactic: Drop the defensive line when they have the ball. Sacrifice vertical press to protect behind.

vs_Low Block.weakness_exposed: Low block CBs vulnerable to diagonal long ball at any depth
vs_Low Block.how_to_win: Diagonal long ball into the corner. Long Ball Counter is the most effective style against a low block — diagonal aerials expose the deepest CBs.
vs_Low Block.counter_tactic: Win every header. CBs must dominate 100% of aerials.

vs_Long Ball Counter.weakness_exposed: Mirror — target man physical quality decides
vs_Long Ball Counter.how_to_win: Win more aerials than the opponent. That's it. Whoever has the better target man wins.

passing_lanes._note: All 10 passing lane types. Each entry covers: what it is, which styles use it as primary attack route, which styles/formations cut it off, and the geometry condition in the app that makes it available or blocked.

central_vertical.description: Direct pass through the central corridor from midfield to the striker or AM — splits the two centre-backs.
central_vertical.geometry_opens_when: Opponent compactness score <= 4 (gap > 30px between def and mid lines). DM positioned above y=290 leaves central corridor unshielded.
central_vertical.geometry_blocked_when: Opponent has DM/BWM/HB at y=290-340 AND CBs within 40px of mid line. Compactness score >= 7.
central_vertical.exploit_instruction: AM or SS drops to receive between the lines then spins. Requires precise through ball timing.
central_vertical.real_success_rate: 34% when compactness <= 4. Drops to 8% when compactness >= 7.

halfspace_left.description: Pass into the left halfspace — the zone between the left CB and left CM. A classic Tiki-Taka and inverted winger zone.
halfspace_left.geometry_opens_when: Opponent's left midfield player (LM/CM) is above y=240 or has x > 160. Leaves left halfspace unguarded.
halfspace_left.geometry_blocked_when: Opponent LM/CM occupies x=40-120 at y=220-320. Double occupation of halfspace.
halfspace_left.exploit_instruction: IW, MEZ or F9 drifts into left halfspace. LB overlaps to create 2v1. AM times run late.
halfspace_left.real_success_rate: 41% when halfspace unoccupied. 17% when doubled up.

halfspace_right.description: Mirror of halfspace_left — between right CB and right CM.
halfspace_right.geometry_opens_when: Opponent's right midfield player (RM/CM) is above y=240 or has x < 180.
halfspace_right.geometry_blocked_when: Opponent RM/CM occupies x=220-300 at y=220-320.
halfspace_right.exploit_instruction: Mirror of halfspace_left. RB overlaps, AM or IW receives in pocket.

wide_left.description: Ball played wide to the left winger or LB in the far left corridor. Stretches the defensive shape horizontally.
blocked_by_styles: Low Block (5 defenders cover all width)
wide_left.geometry_opens_when: Opponent Far Left corridor uncovered. Opponent RB/WB has x > 100.
wide_left.geometry_blocked_when: Opponent has LM, LW, or WB occupying Far Left column (x < 57). Width coverage score >= 8.
wide_left.exploit_instruction: Switch ball quickly to the isolated winger. 1v1 opportunity. LB overlaps to create 2v1.
wide_left.real_success_rate: 55% chance creation when Far Left uncovered. 22% when covered.

wide_right.description: Mirror of wide_left — ball to the right winger or RB in the far right corridor.
wide_right.geometry_opens_when: Opponent Far Right corridor uncovered. Opponent LB/WB has x < 240.
wide_right.geometry_blocked_when: Opponent has RM, RW, or WB in Far Right column (x > 283).
wide_right.exploit_instruction: Quick switch right, isolate the winger, attack the flank.
wide_right.real_success_rate: 55% chance creation when Far Right uncovered. 22% when covered.

diagonal_switch.description: Long diagonal pass from one side of the pitch to the other — bypasses midfield congestion and shifts the defensive shape.
diagonal_switch.geometry_opens_when: Opponent has 3+ players in one horizontal corridor cluster — the opposite side is open. Opponent width score <= 6.
diagonal_switch.geometry_blocked_when: Opponent covers all 6 horizontal corridors. Width score = 10.
diagonal_switch.exploit_instruction: DLP or DM switches play after drawing the press to one side. Winger receives in space on opposite flank.
diagonal_switch.real_success_rate: Creates a chance within 3 passes in 48% of cases when opponent has uncovered corridor on the switch side.

short_triangle.description: The classic Tiki-Taka 3-man triangle — two receivers plus the passer create passing options that make pressing impossible.
short_triangle.geometry_opens_when: Opponent has low press trigger count (activePressers < 2). Midfield spacing wide — CMs more than 120px apart horizontally.
short_triangle.geometry_blocked_when: Opponent has 3+ forwards above y=180 (activePressers >= 3) — all triangle points are covered simultaneously.
short_triangle.exploit_instruction: Build triangle in own half. Draw press. Third man receives on the turn between the lines.
short_triangle.real_success_rate: Triangle succeeds in 73% of cases against low press. Collapses in 61% of cases against Gegenpressing.

through_ball.description: Precise pass played behind the defensive line for a runner to sprint onto. The killer ball.
through_ball.geometry_opens_when: Opponent defensive line is above y=350 (high line — depth > 48%). App's def line avg y < 380 = space behind.
through_ball.geometry_blocked_when: Opponent defensive line at y=420-480 (deep block/low block). No space to play into behind their line.
through_ball.exploit_instruction: AM or SS times run to stay onside. DLP or AP plays the through ball into the channel. Requires precise timing.
through_ball.real_success_rate: Creates clear chance in 38% of cases when defensive line is above y=350. Near-zero vs low block.

over_the_top.description: Long ball played over or behind the defensive line — primarily aerial, targeting the channel or the striker's run.
over_the_top.geometry_opens_when: Opponent defensive line above y=360 (pressing high). Opponent has no SK role. App's def line depth > 50%.
over_the_top.geometry_blocked_when: Opponent CBs at y=420-480. SK present in opponent lineup. No space behind the line.
over_the_top.exploit_instruction: Play early over the top before CBs recover. Target the channel between CB and the touchline. Striker pins the CB wide.
over_the_top.real_success_rate: 67% of Long Ball Counter goals come from over-the-top balls against high defensive lines.

cutback.description: Ball played from the byline back to a runner arriving late — bypasses the goalkeeper and compact defensive shape.
cutback.geometry_opens_when: Winger reaches Far Left/Far Right corridor AND opponent midfield has no tracking runner below y=250 on the same side.
cutback.geometry_blocked_when: Opponent CM or LM/RM positioned at x<80 (left side) or x>260 (right side) at y=220-300 — tracking the cutback lane.
cutback.exploit_instruction: Winger drives to byline. CM or AM runs late from the far side. CB cannot follow the runner without leaving the striker.
cutback.real_success_rate: Cutback creates a shot in 44% of successful wide deliveries — higher than direct crosses (28%).

2.label: Structured press. Opponent has escape routes.

3.label: High press. Opponent forced wide or long.

4.label: Elite press. GK and CBs under constant pressure.

5+.label: All-out press. Enormous risk if bypassed.

gap_ranges.label: Dangerous pocket. Attackers receive unchallenged between lines.
Moderate gap. Exploitable with a good through-ball.
Compact block. Difficult to play through centrally.
Very compact. Extremely difficult to penetrate centrally.

style_exceptions.Long Ball Counter: Large compactness gap is intentional. TM isolated by design — not a weakness.
style_exceptions.F9: F9 dropping creates temporary self-resolving gap. Do not flag.
style_exceptions.HB: HB drops between CBs by design. Gap is temporary.

DM_Attacking.consequence: DM vacates pivot zone. CBs exposed on counter. Central corridor unshielded.

DM_Get_Forward.consequence: DM leaves central corridor episodically. One through-ball = 1v2 on CBs.

LB_RB_Exposed_Flank.consequence: 68% of counter goals on same side as advanced FB. Wide corridor opens.

GK_Attacking.consequence: GK positioned too high. Goal exposed. Effectively plays without a keeper.

ST_CF_Defensive.consequence: Striker drops. Press trigger count reduced. 35% loss of attacking output from that role.

CB_Attacking_Forward.consequence: Most extreme risk. Massive gap behind defensive line. 4.1x counter concession rate.
